Finishes what 0.22.5 started: the meeting screen no longer asks you to pick a folder at all, and duplicated folders from older versions merge themselves on first launch.

## One question, not two

0.22.5 made the customer decide where a recording belongs — but the meeting screen's 存到 picker still listed every personal folder, so starting a meeting looked like two separate filing decisions. It isn't anymore: the picker offers the personal root and your organizations, nothing else. Pick the customer; the filing follows.

If your default save location pointed at a personal folder, it now points at the root — for meetings with a customer that setting never mattered, and meetings without one belong in 還沒歸戶 by definition.

## Duplicate folders merge themselves

Some libraries carried two folders with the same name — an old syncing bug minted separate ids for the same folder, and every folder list showed both. On first launch after this update they merge: recordings move onto the surviving folder (the one paired with your customer, when there is one), and the copies are removed here and in the cloud. Two customers that genuinely share a name are left untouched.
